mostWorthwhile.text: Following insulin to muscle was most worthwhile because it showed how a pancreas message helps glucose leave the blood and enter cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Setting up falling blood glucose was fairly predictable after the after-meal route, although it made the comparison clear.

surprise.text: I noticed that the pancreas releases less insulin after blood glucose falls, rather than just sending a constant message.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but the liver-release message was not named, so I understood its job better than what it was.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: comparing the two responses was clear, though the later choices mostly followed the only offered action.
